title: CyberDeck Control-Plane Envelope
description: IDE ⇄ engine control-plane message envelope (Q4 default: WebSocket + JSON on localhost). Lineage: extends the engine transport envelope (engine/core/transport/envelope.go v/ch/type/seq/ts) with request/response correlation and subscription framing. Error payloads follow error.schema.json. CD-113.

id.description: unique message id (uuid); response.correlation echoes it

correlation.description: the request id this frame answers; required on response/error/event-for-subscription frames

seq.description: per-subscription monotonic sequence for gap detection + resume

payload.description: request args / response body / event data; shape is the route's request or response schema

resumeFrom.description: on subscribe: last seq the client already has; engine replays from seq+1 or sends a reset event if it cannot

credits.description: backpressure: max in-flight events the client will buffer; engine pauses past this until more credits arrive

reset.description: on event: true means the engine could not resume from resumeFrom — client must re-sync from this snapshot
